1410498378488819714.a: Coconut, Sesame, (nonEV) Olive Oil are my gotos. Palm oil, beef tallow are not cheap. I take DHA, EPA for my eyes every day. I fry meat (salmon, beef, birds) in nut oil, veggies in water. For me, mixing tree and animal oils results in balanced cholesterol (based on blood tests).

1410516401236942848.a: I would stress that this advice is for me alone. If you find it useful to take the advice I give myself more power to you. But talk to nutritionists and doctors. Your needs will be different from everyone else. t.co

1410516406765035523.a: Again, this is the diet I have built talking to nutritionists and my primary care doctor who needs the blood tests to monitor meds anyway. Well worth the effort to use that info to balance diet. No need to decide exactly what to eat. Be flexible, eat different stuff every day. t.co

1410517452186865665.a: Don't skip the water. You need water in copious amounts to digest food. If you are already having trouble digesting food trying to bullshit yourself into believing water tastes funny will not help you live healthy. Drink sugary stuff with the meal too but start and end with water

1410520262727110656.a: Drink RO filtered water. Use a clear glass to drink and clear bottle to store your water. You need to know if there is backwash & fungus in the water. If you hate the taste of water then fungal contamination may be the issue. Each morning I fill a 1gal bottle and empty it by bed.
